findings.message: 3 tl.fromTo() calls target "proxy (unresolved DOM association)" with no stable baseline. The last-authored fromTo "from" values become the element's resting state for any seek before the first tween actually runs, because GSAP applies fromTo from-values at authoring time (immediateRender), not at tween position.
findings.fixHint: Add `immediateRender: false` to every fromTo except the earliest-positioned one (at 58.558s), so pre-first-tween seeks keep its "from" values. A hiding `tl.set(..., 0)` baseline trips gsap_timeline_set_initial_hide, and a `gsap.set` authored before the fromTo calls is overwritten by them.

findings.message: GSAP tween on "#d58-s0-dg-b0" uses motion that snaps to integer device pixels: top. Layout and text-reflow properties snap during browser layout; roundProps rounds the tween value. Slow motion or an ease-out tail then stutters under the seek-by-frame capture engine. Animate transforms (x/y/scale/opacity) instead.
findings.fixHint: replace top with the transform equivalent (y), e.g. tl.fromTo("#d58-s0-dg-b0", { x: -1300 }, { x: 0, ...yourAnimation }). Transforms interpolate sub-pixel and stay smooth at any speed.
